bhorn.text: A regular since 2016, Bhorn still plays with quick hands and sits comfortably in the upper tier of everyone tracked, standing firm against strong opposition. The lifetime board tells a taller tale than the matchups do, though, and against the toughest third of their opponents a big slice of the edge disappears. Built from an older, smaller opponent sample, so read this one as a sketch.

b33rd.text: b33rd plays the steady middle of the game: square in the middle of the pack in the matchups, quick-handed, and holding up fine when the opposition stiffens. The lifetime board is a little kinder than the matchups, painting a slightly taller picture. A reliable regular, the kind who keeps the fight honest without ever needing the spotlight.

bloozytoozy.text: BloozyToozy fights like the fight is already won: among the very best tracked, output strong as the opposition improves. A furious tempo drives the whole game. Lifetime and matchup numbers agree, which keeps the story simple, and what survives against the strongest third dips a little. A confident game, played at full speed.

blueicecreamnk.text: BlueIceCreamNK is strong everywhere and weak nowhere: among the steadiest producers in the game, camped at the very top, and undaunted whatever the fight throws at them. The lifetime numbers match the matchups, which keeps the record tidy. The kind of regular who turns every fight into work.

bobeqh.text: Bobeqh is a young account with a loud opening: sitting near the very top, with the best accuracy on the board. Headshots almost never land, and the lifetime IvI hangs near the bottom, which leaves the matchups carrying the real story. Early days, but the first pages are hard to ignore.

beric.text: Beric brings a fast, fearless game to every fight: among the top bracket, a pace that sits among the very fastest, while the numbers rise as the enemies get stronger. The lifetime ledger mostly agrees with the matchups, with the kill-death line a touch cooler. Treat this one as a rough sketch: the opponent sample behind it is older and smaller.

berlc.text: BERlC mixes precision with pace: top of the heap in the matchups, with a blistering firing rhythm, and aim landing near the summit. Bravery sits at the very top of the card, and the shape holds against harder foes. The lifetime ledger tells a similar story, with the kill-death line sitting a notch cooler.

bass91.text: Bass91 has been at this since 2014, and the years show in the best way: top shelf in the matchups, steady as foes get stronger, and deadly without needing headshots. The headshot line sits below average, yet the results never notice. The lifetime IvI board reads merely middling, so the public numbers sell a long, strong career short.

bastel2802.text: Bastel2802 has been at this since 2012: top shelf for the matchups, with the matchup kill-death line up near the top. Tempo stays above average and the aim stays steady, while the lifetime IvI number sits a little behind. A long career, still played with patience.

boomdeboossa.text: BoomDeBoossa is days old and already top shelf: upper tier in the matchups, with a top-gear pace and nerve to match. The lifetime ledger runs close behind the matchups, and the aim sits near the top. Early read, but the very first pages are loud.

baumblue.text: BaumBLue is a storm: matchup rating near the top, bravery near the summit, and a tempo that never fades. The accuracy is near the top, the headshot share too, and the edge holds up against the hardest third too. A player who seeks out the hardest fights and usually wins them.

blackbirdeutr.text: BlackbirdEUTR arrived in 2026 and already plays like a fixture: the rating tops the card, the output pours in, the courage holds, the staying power never fades. The matchup kill-death mark comes along for the ride. The aim is precise, headshots sit above average, and the lifetime board rates the career near the summit. Consistency holds in the middle — the only ordinary line on a remarkable card.

bebbeesme.text: BEBBEESME has been fighting since 2013, and the card reads like an old hand's ledger: matchup rating near the top, resistance to match, and a matchup kill-death mark that stays elite. The activity and bravery sit above average, while the pace, accuracy, and lifetime board all land mid-pack. Nothing flashy — just a veteran who wins the fights that count, year after year.

beetlerush.text: BeetleRush is five days into the record books and already playing like a fixture: activity at the very top, kill pace to match, and a matchup rating near the summit. The aim is precise, the headshot share sits near the top, and the lifetime board rates them among the very best. Only consistency dips low against the strongest third — an early read, but a loud one.

beyondthemind.text: BeyondTheMind is the definition of complete: rating, activity, bravery, resistance, and matchup kill-death all sit near the very top, with a brisk kill pace and a precise aim. Headshots land near the top too, and the lifetime board rates them among the very best. Consistency holds mid-pack, the one line that stays ordinary — a veteran's card with no soft spot since 2017.

blackbirdeuvs.text: BlackbirdEUVS arrived in 2026 and already plays like a fixture: matchup rating, tempo, and bravery all near the very top, resistance included. Accuracy is the standout, sitting near the very top of everyone tracked, while the lifetime board rates them among the best too. The headshot share is the one middling line; consistency sits mid-pack, but the early pages already carry real weight.

baoshuang.text: BaoShuang has played a steady top-shelf game since 2017: the matchup rating and activity sit near the top, resistance too, and a matchup kill-death figure alongside. The game climbs with the opposition, and the edge holds firm against the strongest third too. Aim sits above average, with headshots running near the top, and the lifetime board tells the same story.

ben1337.text: Ben1337 is pure tempo: activity and bravery both top-rank, a pace up with the fastest, and aim that lands true with headshots to spare. The matchup rating sits in the top ranks too, and the lifetime tally agrees with the matchup picture. The strongest third finds the weak seam — everything else on the card runs hot.

basiliskappreciator.text: BasiliskAppreciator is the complete article: every line lands at the top or above, with no soft spot anywhere on the card. The pace stays brisk, the aim stays precise, and the lifetime board rates them near the top. A fighter with nothing to patch and everything to show for it.

beansstupideridiot.text: Beansstupideridiot wastes no time announcing themself: a young account with the card already reading top shelf on almost every line, and the lifetime board at the very summit. The game holds as the opposition strengthens, the aim is precise, with headshots landing at a leading rate. Nothing sags, nothing lags — the whole card reads like a finished portrait. Early read, but few openings have ever looked this complete.

blackbirdeunc.text: BlackbirdEUNC carries one of the cleanest cards in the game: matchup rating, pace, and aim all at the top, with bravery that grows as the enemies get stronger. A rising fighter on the scene since 2026, with the results to back every bit of it.

bigboss0k.text: BigBoss0K brings polish and volume in equal measure: a top-shelf rating, accuracy near the summit, and a game that holds up as the opposition improves. The headshot share sits above average, and the lifetime IvI ends up above average too, a notch below the matchups. A newer account, already leaving a mark.

burkeso.text: Burkeso leaves almost nothing to complain about: every line on the card lands near the top, from the matchup rating to the lifetime IvI, with bravery, resistance, and accuracy all in the same rarefied air. Consistency lands mid-pack, which only shows how high the rest of the bar sits. A rounded fighter, scarcely a crack anywhere, with every line backing the next.

brrrrrrrrrrtr.text: BRRRRRRRRRRTR does not believe in a quiet fight: the kill rate and the tempo both sit near the very top, and the game strengthens as the enemies get tougher, while the matchup rating sits in the same band. bjoereknc.text: BjoerekNC brings a full-throttle game to every fight: upper tier in the matchups, relentless tempo, and unshaken no matter how hard the other side pushes. battlerogue.text: battlerogue never seems to stand still: in the top flight of the matchups, relentless on the trigger, and still pushing as the going gets tougher.
